cards.example_en: She reached the peak of the hill just before noon.
cards.example_zh: 她就在中午前登上了小山的顶点。

cards.example_en: The bus comes once per hour.
cards.example_zh: 公交车每小时来一班。

cards.example_en: I could perceive a change in her voice.
cards.example_zh: 我能察觉她声音的变化。

cards.example_en: What percentage of the class passed?
cards.example_zh: 班上及格的百分比是多少？

cards.example_en: Her performance in the play was excellent.
cards.example_zh: 她在剧中的表现非常出色。

cards.example_en: Ink from that pen leaves a permanent mark on shirts.
cards.example_zh: 那种钢笔的墨水会在衬衫上留下永久的印记。

cards.example_en: The school does not permit mobile phones during morning exams.
cards.example_zh: 学校不允许在上午的考试中使用手机。

cards.example_en: Teams trust him because of his calm personality.
cards.example_zh: 因为他的人格很沉稳，队友们都信任他。

cards.example_en: Can you persuade your brother to share the last cake?
cards.example_zh: 你能说服弟弟分享最后一块蛋糕吗？

cards.example_en: Don't be pessimistic before you try.
cards.example_zh: 还没尝试就不要悲观。

cards.example_en: We ran out of petrol halfway to the countryside.
cards.example_zh: 去乡下走到半路，我们的汽油用完了。

cards.example_en: The building is now in the final phase of repair.
cards.example_zh: 这栋楼的修缮现在到了最后阶段。

cards.example_en: Global warming is a worldwide phenomenon.
cards.example_zh: 全球变暖是世界性的现象。

cards.example_en: He lives by a simple philosophy: homework comes before play.
cards.example_zh: 他奉行一个简单的哲学：先完成作业再玩。

cards.example_en: The photographer took pictures of the team.
cards.example_zh: 摄影师给队伍拍了照。

cards.example_en: I forgot the French phrase for asking the price.
cards.example_zh: 我忘了用法语问价格的那个短语。

cards.example_en: The physician told him to rest.
cards.example_zh: 医生让他休息。

cards.example_en: Water leaked from the pipe.
cards.example_zh: 管子漏水了。

cards.example_en: She wore a plain dress to the family dinner.
cards.example_zh: 她穿了一条朴素的裙子去参加家庭晚餐。

cards.example_en: The train leaves from platform 4.
cards.example_zh: 火车从4号站台出发。

cards.example_en: The youngest player scored the winning goal.
cards.example_zh: 最年轻的选手打进了制胜一球。

cards.example_en: A pleasant breeze cooled us during the picnic.
cards.example_zh: 野餐时，一阵令人愉快的微风让我们凉快下来。

cards.example_en: The plot twisted when the detective guessed wrong.
cards.example_zh: 侦探猜错的时候，剧情发生了转折。

cards.example_en: Put the plug in the socket.
cards.example_zh: 把插头插进插座。

cards.example_en: The ticket is twenty yuan, plus a small booking fee.
cards.example_zh: 票价二十元，另加一点订票费。

cards.example_en: We read poetry aloud beneath the old tree.
cards.example_zh: 我们在那棵老树下朗读诗歌。

cards.example_en: Keep the poison away from children.
cards.example_zh: 把毒药放在孩子碰不到的地方。

cards.example_en: Polar bears live in the polar region.
cards.example_zh: 北极熊生活在极地。

cards.example_en: The flag hangs from a tall pole.
cards.example_zh: 旗子挂在一根高杆上。

cards.example_en: School policy bans snacks inside the science lab.
cards.example_zh: 学校方针禁止在科学实验室里吃零食。

cards.example_en: Please polish your shoes before the show.
cards.example_zh: 演出前请把鞋擦亮。

cards.example_en: The mayor gave a political speech in the town square.
cards.example_zh: 市长在镇广场上发表了政治演讲。

cards.example_en: The politician answered questions from our class.
cards.example_zh: 那位政客回答了我们班提出的问题。

cards.example_en: We discussed politics in class.
cards.example_zh: 我们在课上讨论了政治。

cards.example_en: Air pollution is a serious problem in big cities.
cards.example_zh: 空气污染是大城市的严重问题。

cards.example_en: Ducks swam on the pond.
cards.example_zh: 鸭子在池塘里游。

cards.example_en: The ship reached the port at dawn.
cards.example_zh: 船在黎明抵达港口。

cards.example_en: Pose for a photo by the tree.
cards.example_zh: 在树旁摆个姿势拍照。

cards.example_en: That old violin is his most treasured possession.
cards.example_zh: 那把旧小提琴是他最珍爱的所有物。

cards.example_en: We put a poster on the classroom wall.
cards.example_zh: 我们把一张海报贴在教室墙上。

cards.example_en: We may postpone the picnic if it rains.
cards.example_zh: 如果下雨，我们可能推迟野餐。

cards.example_en: She has the potential to be a great singer.
cards.example_zh: 她有潜力成为一名出色的歌手。

cards.example_en: These practical shoes are good for walking to school.
cards.example_zh: 这双实用的鞋很适合走路去上学。

cards.example_en: Some families pray together before the evening meal.
cards.example_zh: 有些家庭在晚饭前一起祈祷。

cards.example_en: Time is precious before an exam.
cards.example_zh: 考试前时间很珍贵。

cards.example_en: Please arrive at eight precisely.
cards.example_zh: 请准时八点到。

cards.example_en: Old farmers predict a storm when the swallows fly low.
cards.example_zh: 燕子低飞时，老农便能预测暴风雨将至。

cards.example_en: My preference is a window seat on the long train.
cards.example_zh: 我偏爱长途火车上靠窗的座位。

cards.example_en: We should judge people without prejudice.
cards.example_zh: 我们评判人时不应带偏见。

cards.example_en: The premier visited the new school.
cards.example_zh: 总理参观了这所新学校。

word.example_en: She is in possession of the only key.
word.example_zh: 她持有那把唯一的钥匙。
